name: Miltaur
source:
Owner of a seaside restaurant on Jusei. His role is something like the market's chief coordinator: he has no formal authority, but he has connections everywhere, and nearby merchants all have to stay on his good side.

[From [url=https://pirahus.com/en/]official website[/url]]
